_readme: Confidence thresholds for the typed-judgment consumers, PER QUESTION KIND and PER PROVIDER.
these shipped values are the PRE-CALIBRATION defaults and are deliberately high.
Posture until calibration has run on real Woven data: flag, never block.
low  - below this, escalate the item to a Claude read
high - at or above this, the verdict may be acted on
noul - the 0-1 point at which a noul statement counts as TRUE
Lookup order: providers[p][kind], providers[p].default, kind, default.
Clef at 0.8 does not mean Jev at 0.8, so calibrated bands go under providers[<judge id>].
trustPass (per provider and kind) lets a confident typed PASS skip the model call it shadows.
Only jev_calibrate.py writes trustPass, from a labelled set; never the UI, never by hand.
